What happens in account recovery
- We’ll verify ownership using alternative proofs since you can’t use the usual contact methods.

- Last 4 digits of the payment card on file or bank account descriptor
- Recent login timestamps or IP/city (approximate is fine)

3) Proof of authority
- If you’re acting on behalf of a company: your role/title and a company email address

- For individual accounts: a photo ID that matches the account name (you can redact non-essential info)

- The new email address you want on the account

Notes on urgency

Reply with the details you can provide now, and I’ll proceed to create the recovery case and share the secure upload link.
